svg.title: Binferno: from mixed DNA to genome bins

g.text: Binferno | From mixed DNA to genome bins
Goal: sort assembled DNA pieces into groups likely to come from the same genome.
Optional: simplify signatures with PCA / UMAP before grouping.
Optional during learning: marker genes help keep different genomes apart.
A genome bin is a collection of DNA pieces — an approximate genome, which may still be incomplete.
Solid arrows: main workflow Dashed arrows: optional taxonomy guidance
